scripts.dev: npm run build -w @axiom/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @axiom/api" "npm run dev -w @axiom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @axiom/contracts && npm run build -w @axiom/api && npm run build -w @axiom/web && npm run build -w @axiom/site
scripts.test: npm run build -w @axiom/contracts && npm run architecture && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
